title: My Red Card
text:
I have a red card. It has a picture of an apple. The word is apple.

I read the card every morning. I say the word three times. Then I smile.

questions.text: How many times does the speaker say the word?
How does the speaker probably feel when reading the card?
Why does the speaker read the card every morning?

vocabulary.definition: a small piece of stiff paper
a round red or green fruit

paragraph_translations: Mam czerwoną kartę. Ma obrazek jabłka. Słowo to apple.
Czytam kartę każdego ranka. Mówię słowo trzy razy. Potem się uśmiecham.
